evidence.quote: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.
Finally, in the afternoon of July 4th, the Declaration was adopted.
Congress appointed on June 10 a committee of five to draft a statement of independence
Jefferson drafted the statement between June 11 and 28
the approved Declaration was printed on July 5th
On July 19th, Congress ordered that the Declaration be engrossed on parchment
On August 2nd John Hancock, the President of the Congress, signed the engrossed copy

objectives: Sequence the drafting, adoption, printing, engrossing, and signing of the Declaration in chronological order
Recall the dates of committee appointment, draft preparation, congressional revision, printing, engrossing order, and signing
